title: Supercritical Branching Random Walks on Nested Lattices
summary: In classical models of supercritical continuous-time branching random walks (BRWs) on a $d$-dimensional lattice, the dimension $d$ is typically assumed to be fixed. When comparing the exponential growth rate $λ_0$ of a particle population in a BRW with a single branching source across lattices of different dimensions, a question arises whether it is possible to construct a family of random walks on $d$-dimensional lattices such that the model for a $(d+1)$-dimensional lattice ``inherits'' the properties of the model for a $d$-dimensional lattice in a meaningful sense.
